"""Step 1: Preliminary audio analysis of the Brahms recording."""
import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf

audio, sr = sf.read("materials/recording.wav")
print(f"Sample rate: {sr}, Duration: {len(audio)/sr:.2f}s, Shape: {audio.shape}")
print(f"Peak amplitude: {np.max(np.abs(audio)):.4f}")

# Compute RMS energy over time for onset detection
import librosa

# Onset detection
onset_frames = librosa.onset.onset_detect(y=audio, sr=sr, units='frames',
                                           backtrack=True, wait=2, pre_max=3, post_max=3)
onset_times = librosa.frames_to_time(onset_frames, sr=sr)
print(f"\nDetected {len(onset_times)} onsets")
for i, t in enumerate(onset_times):
    print(f"  Onset {i:3d}: {t:.2f}s")

# Also try spectral flux onsets
onset_frames2 = librosa.onset.onset_detect(y=audio, sr=sr, units='frames',
                                            backtrack=True)
onset_times2 = librosa.frames_to_time(onset_frames2, sr=sr)
print(f"\nSpectral flux onsets: {len(onset_times2)}")

# Tempo estimation
tempo, beats = librosa.beat.beat_track(y=audio, sr=sr)
print(f"\nEstimated tempo: {tempo:.1f} BPM")
beat_times = librosa.frames_to_time(beats, sr=sr)
print(f"Beat times: {', '.join(f'{t:.2f}' for t in beat_times[:20])}...")
print(f"Total beats: {len(beat_times)}")

# For 16 bars of 3/4 = 48 beats + pickup, so ~49 beats
# At Andante (~ 50-70 BPM), 49 beats takes about 42-59 seconds
# Our recording is 62.7s, suggesting tempo around quarter = 47
expected_beats = 49  # 16 bars × 3 beats + 1 pickup beat
estimated_tempo_manual = expected_beats / (len(audio) / sr) * 60
print(f"Manual tempo estimate (49 beats / {len(audio)/sr:.1f}s): {estimated_tempo_manual:.1f} BPM")
